QuestInfo.name: [Detective Rave's Case Notes] Scrappy Hero
QuestInfo.0:
You found the crashed ship in #bSeedy Scrapyard 1#k. While you were surrounded by Hooligans, someone called #bDetective Rave#k made a fancy entry.  

You decide to talk to Rave.
QuestInfo.1: Rave thinks something sharp, like the #bBig Nails#k from Prickly Hedgehogs in #bSeedy Scrapyard 1#k might give you the leverage you need to pry open the ship and get you inside. He wants an awful lot of them...
QuestInfo.2: The ship was empty! Seems like the trail ran cold, but Detective Rave has some advice. \r

default.0: It's 25 Big Nails. You didn't forget, did you?
